# Lane 2 tests allowed to skip for unavailable backend or bench tools, each with the
# reason it gives. A test here may skip without failing the lane, but never
# fail; one that passes is reported so its line can go. The script reads
# top-level results only: TestDmabufClientMaps/maps also skips here, because
# vkms has no render node for its client to allocate on.
TestNestedSessionEndsWhenLastOutputCloses needs the nested backend: it closes the host window
TestOutputFollowsHostResize needs the nested backend: the host resizes its window
TestNativeIBusComposesInGTK requires packaged IBus and Python GTK introspection; exercised on the baremetal bench
